notes: Both italics are added: the *and* has no waw to answer to (rule 14's closing sentence), and the *hath* has no possessive morpheme left unspent on rule 43's count, since the עַל holds *upon* and the suffix holds *his*.
כֻּלָּם is split with the suffix taking the subject pronoun *They* and כֹּל only *all*; the ASV writes no *of them*, so rule 19's *all of them* shape is not in play.
מִפַּחַד → *Because of* fuses under rule 30 as a compound preposition of which no morpheme owns a part, headed on *Because* by rule 24, while פַּחַד keeps its own *fear*.
